authorization.scope: local implementation and verification; not fabricated human consent, independent closure or deployment receipt

tools.name: manage_company_admin
tools.requiredAuthority: Current human identity + `S:A`; admin for propose/transfer/revoke, named recipient for accept/decline, proposer/current admin for cancel; exact recent-auth H. Observer identities excluded.
tools.objectRule: Same organization, exact target/proposal/assignment and versions; pending proposals confer no authority; last active human admin preserved.
tools.requiredEvidence: Exact consent, immutable role/proposal evidence and event; elevation/revocation invalidates affected connections.

tools.name: manage_member_admin_delegation
tools.requiredAuthority: Current human admin + `S:A`; exact recent-auth H.
tools.objectRule: Exactly one active board and active human secretary; grant expiry at most 90 days; no onward delegation.
tools.requiredEvidence: Exact consent, reason, 1–8 board-readable immutable appointment citations, grant/revoke event and connection invalidation.

tools.name: list_administrative_access
tools.requiredAuthority: Current human identity + `S:A`; own mode only, or current admin for organization mode.
tools.objectRule: Own rights/pending offers only by default; exact organization/optional board filter and signed actor/generation-bound pagination; no private cross-board inventory.
tools.requiredEvidence: Bounded current authority and pending proposal references; at most 100 entries; no tokens or credential material.

securityRequirements.requirement: Administrator appointments require current scoped human admin proposal and exact named-recipient acceptance; cancel, decline, revoke and atomic transfer retain their permanent lineage.
All administrator/member-removal paths share a serializable last-active-human-admin invariant; transfer preserves other roles, seats and historical governance evidence.
Board-member administration delegation is exact-board, expiring, non-transitive and limited to ordinary human voting directors; self, observer/AI, privileged and organization-wide targets are denied.
New administrative authority invalidates pre-elevation connections; revoked/expired/ended authority cannot survive cached tokens, refresh families, browser sessions or pending confirmation stages.
Administrative discovery and pagination expose only own grants/offers or explicitly admin-authorized organization results; protected target denial cannot disclose another board's roles.
Administrative finalizers enforce live authority, immutable evidence, fresh exact consent and atomic audit under runtime DB roles; migrations/exports/restores preserve these invariants.
Deterministic registry composition retains original frozen bytes and accepts only the exact implementation-authorized additive amendment and expected resulting counts.
Supported first-account activation and existing authorized-human recovery preserve actual human proof, one-time secrets and separation of operator, company admin, secretary and voter authority.

threats.scenario: Forged or stale administrator offer acceptance
threats.expectedControl: SR-095; only named eligible human with fresh exact stage and live issuer can accept

threats.scenario: Concurrent loss of all active administrators
threats.expectedControl: SR-096; common organization lock and serializable last-admin invariant across old and new paths

threats.scenario: Cross-board or transitive secretary privilege escalation
threats.expectedControl: SR-097; operation/board/protected-target allowlist checked at prepare and commit

threats.scenario: Cached token inherits elevation or retains revoked grant
threats.expectedControl: SR-098; live grant resolution plus affected connection invalidation and fresh reconnect

threats.scenario: Administrative list/cursor reveals another board or person
threats.expectedControl: SR-099; own/admin read branch and signed scope-bound cursor

threats.scenario: Runtime SQL bypass or partially committed role/audit transition
threats.expectedControl: SR-100; FORCE RLS, narrow finalizers, mandatory exact consent/audit and transactional rollback

threats.scenario: Hand-edited registry, unapproved delta or erased original authority
threats.expectedControl: SR-101; pinned base/amendment hashes, closed delta and unchanged original-row assertions

threats.scenario: Bootstrap/recovery invents human identity or revives departed authority
threats.expectedControl: SR-102; supported operator ceremony, actual proof and strict generation/recovery policy

acceptanceScenarios.outcome: A company administrator proposes another eligible human, who personally accepts and reconnects; atomic transfer ends old admin authority while preserving ordinary rights and history.
A senior secretary receives an expiring exact-board director-management grant, completes an evidenced appointment and is denied other boards, privileged targets and onward delegation.
Supported bootstrap, upgrade, recovery, revocation and restore preserve administrative authority and allow separated secretary/director client identities without fabricated human consent.

modifyTools.name: manage_member
modifyTools.requiredAuthority: Current human admin + `S:A`, OR current human secretary with live exact-board member-administration delegation + `S:A` and strictly allowed operation/target.
modifyTools.objectRule: Admin behavior preserved. Delegate: non-null granted board only, ordinary human voting director, no self/privileged/observer/management/AI target, no secretary/admin/other-delegate changes or onward delegation.
modifyTools.requiredEvidence: Existing exact H and history/revocation, plus immutable board-readable appointment citations and bounded reason for delegated changes.

manage_company_admin.result: Existing surface-result envelope; boardagent.administrative-change.v1 data with operation, immutable record ID/version, state, affected member IDs, effective powers and reconnect_required; never a credential.

grant.expires_at: UTC RFC3339; database now < value <= now + 90 days
grant.authority_evidence: 1..8 unique existing CitationSchema objects; immutable version/hash/clause/locator; visible in exact board

manage_member_admin_delegation.result: Existing surface-result envelope; boardagent.administrative-change.v1 as above.

fields.cursor: existing signed cursor; max4096; default null

list_administrative_access.result: Existing read envelope; rows contain only authorized administrative record IDs, kinds, actor/target display IDs, board ID, state/version, validity and readable authority evidence; next_cursor signed for actor, mode, board and generations.

manage_member_delta.delegate_required: authority_evidence always and reason 1..2000 (existing lifecycle change.reason or new invite change.reason)
manage_member_delta.admin_compatibility: Existing admin input remains valid; supplied new evidence is validated and included in exact confirmation. No default fields silently inserted into original arguments.

companyAdminProposal.expiry: Derived invalidity at proposed_at + 24 hours; no worker required and no implicit assignment.
companyAdminProposal.accept: Named target only; issuer still current admin; exact versions and fresh H. Transfer replaces issuer role atomically.
companyAdminProposal.eligibleTarget: Active onboarded human with no effective observer identity; AI/observer, self, inactive and already-admin targets refused. No new observer H exception.

delegation.expiry: Derived from database time; max90days; role loss invalidates grant permanently, reinstatement needs new grant.
delegation.allowedTarget: Active human secretary on exact active board; ordinary voting-director changes only.

invariants: Only exact approved delta; original files and all original verification thresholds preserved.
No new role enum, OAuth scope, provider, egress, runtime dependency or public browser/governance interface.
No extra CLI command: bootstrap activation, if formalized as CLI mode, stays within the existing operator-only bootstrap command and explicit submode contract.
Last-active-human-admin invariant shared with existing member lifecycle and protected by common organization administrative lock.
Grant/revoke/transfer and identity effects invalidate affected credentials and pending H stages without changing historical governance acts.
Prepare and commit both enforce database live authority; no permission from display names or client metadata.
Audit events, exact consent, idempotency, authority history and mutations commit together.
Private reads, signed scope-bound cursors and generic protected-target denial preserve confidentiality.
eventPayload: Existing strict AuditEvent envelope, schemaVersion1; details object includes operation, administrativeRecordId, payloadSha256, exact before/after snapshot and affectedMemberIds; event name must match actual transition. No secret values.

bootstrapMode.input: bounded1024byte JSON on stdin only: activationCode (existing XXX-XXXX alphabet), proofingMethod (in_person|verified_number_call); configured production HTTPS origin and operator migrator context; no identity selection or secret on argv
bootstrapMode.behavior: Invoke existing activateFirstSecretary transaction; no direct state writes; invalid/missing/extra input refuses; return safe activation receipt and next human onboarding step.

unresolvedSecurityClaims: All new SRs remain UNRESOLVED until exact production implementation and executing tests exist; new surface is not qualified or deployed by writing this amendment.
